[[File:Itakura Raiden Shrine Honsha 1.JPG|thumb|220px|Raiden Shrine (群馬県板倉町)]]
'''Raiden Shrine''' (雷電神社) is a name shared by multiple {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}s located primarily in the {{ill|Kantō region|en|Kantō region|qid=Q132480|lt=Kantō region}} of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan}}. These shrines are commonly dedicated to deities associated with protection against {{ill|Thunder|en|Thunder|qid=Q83301|lt=Thunder}}, although their enshrined deities and origins vary.

Similar shrines include {{ill|Raijin Shrine|ja|雷神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raijin Shrine|qq=}} and {{ill|Den Shrine|ja|電神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Den Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.

== Gunma Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Itakura, Gunma)|ja|雷電神社 (板倉町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Itakura, Gunma)|qq=}} – Located in {{ill|Itakura, Gunma|en|Itakura, Gunma|qid=Q1203771|lt=Itakura, Gunma}}, [[Ōra District]], this shrine is also called Itakura Raiden Shrine. It holds an unofficial status as the head shrine of "Raiden Shrines" in the Kantō region. Enshrined deities include {{ill|Yakusanoikazuchi|en|Yakusanoikazuchi|qid=Q10892534|lt=Honoikazuchi-no-Ōkami}}, {{ill|Ōikazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|大雷大神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōikazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, and {{ill|Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|別雷大神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Minami, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市南町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Minami, Maebashi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in [[Minami, Maebashi]] within {{ill|Maebashi|en|Maebashi|qid=Q201613|lt=Maebashi, Gunma}}, behind the main hall of {{ill|Maebashi Shinmeigu|ja|前橋神明宮|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Maebashi Shinmeigu|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Kamishinden, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市上新田町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Kamishinden, Maebashi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Q28682633|ja|上新田町 (前橋市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamishinden, Maebashi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q28682633}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Heiwa, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市平和町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Heiwa, Maebashi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Q24860656|ja|平和町 (前橋市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Heiwa, Maebashi|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q24860656}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Yokosawa, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市横沢町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Yokosawa, Maebashi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in Yokosawa, Maebashi.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Taguchi, Maebashi)|ja|雷電神社 (前橋市田口町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Taguchi, Maebashi)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in Taguchi, Maebashi.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Kiryū)|ja|雷電神社 (桐生市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Kiryū)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Kiryū, Gunma|en|Kiryū, Gunma|qid=Q634022|lt=Kiryū, Gunma}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Isezaki, Sakae-Iyoku)|ja|雷電神社 (伊勢崎市境伊与久)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Isezaki, Sakae-Iyoku)|qq=}} – Located in {{ill|Sakae, Iyoku|ja|境伊与久|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sakae, Iyoku|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Isesaki|en|Isesaki|qid=Q328596|lt=Isezaki, Gunma}}.

== Tochigi Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Hiraide, Utsunomiya)|ja|雷電神社 (宇都宮市平出町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Hiraide, Utsunomiya)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Hiraide, Utsunomiya|ja|平出町 (宇都宮市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiraide, Utsunomiya|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, this shrine is also called Hiraide Raiden Shrine. The shrine enshrines {{ill|Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja|別雷之大神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Wakazuchi-no-Ōkami|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} and nine other deities.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Hosoya, Utsunomiya)|ja|雷電神社 (宇都宮市細谷町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Hosoya, Utsunomiya)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Hosoya, Utsunomiya|ja|細谷町 (宇都宮市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hosoya, Utsunomiya|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Sukedo, Ashikaga)|ja|雷電神社 (足利市助戸東山町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Sukedo, Ashikaga)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Sukedo, Ashikaga|ja|助戸東山町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sukedo, Ashikaga|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, {{ill|Ashikaga, Tochigi|en|Ashikaga, Tochigi|qid=Q374477|lt=Ashikaga, Tochigi}}.

== Saitama Prefecture ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Satte)|ja|雷電神社 (幸手市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Satte)|qq=}} – Located in {{ill|Satte, Saitama|en|Satte, Saitama|qid=Q868971|lt=Satte, Saitama}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Kasukabe)|ja|雷電神社 (春日部市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Kasukabe)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located in {{ill|Kasukabe, Saitama|en|Kasukabe, Saitama|qid=Q376023|lt=Kasukabe, Saitama}}.
* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Saitama City)|ja|雷電神社 (さいたま市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Saitama City)|qq=}} – Located in {{ill|Kombachō|ja|今羽町|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Imawa, Kita-ku|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q17223316}}, {{ill|Saitama (city)|en|Saitama (city)|qid=Q134635|lt=Saitama City}}.
* Raiden Shrine (Tokigawa) – Located in {{ill|Tokigawa, Saitama|en|Tokigawa, Saitama|qid=Q251027|lt=Tokigawa, Saitama}}, atop {{ill|Q11660214|ja|雷電山 (埼玉県)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Mountain (Saitama)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11660214}}.

== Tokyo ==

* {{ill|Raiden Shrine (Shinjuku)|ja|雷電神社 (新宿区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Shrine (Shinjuku)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} – Located at {{ill|Hanazono Shrine|en|Hanazono Shrine|qid=Q3126680|lt=Hanazono Shrine}} in {{ill|Shinjuku|en|Shinjuku|qid=Q179645|lt=Shinjuku, Tokyo}}. Merged with Hanazono Shrine in 1928 but still maintains its presence as {{ill|Raiden Inari Shrine|ja|雷電稲荷神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Raiden Inari Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}.
